before.title: arrive at + 地點

after.content: arrive at + 具體地點（如車站、郵局等），表示「抵達……」。

facts.reason: Correct the malformed 適當於 wording without imposing an absolute place-size rule.

before.title: relate A to B = A is related to B

after.title: relate A to B / A is related to B
after.content: 將 A 與 B 聯繫起來；A is related to B 則表示「A 與 B 有關聯」。

facts.reason: Distinguish the active relating operation from the related-state phrase; only this exact title changes = to /.
